verdict.rationale: Fivetran officially supports building custom connectors for long-tail APIs via the Connector SDK (Python, not a fork), with a documented setup guide and GitHub repo, plus AI coding-agent plugins for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI that add SDK-specific skills for natural-language connector building, testing, and deployment, and a Cursor AI video tutorial — this is a genuine low-code/AI-assisted builder path, not a fork of the product. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reports validating ease/reliability of building a connector this way (evidence is vendor docs only).
